name: Glass podcast player
oneLiner: a glass now-playing card rises with the show's cover art (the author's cut-out on the brand light) lifted off it; play is pressed, the waveform plays a beat, then the playhead is grabbed and scrubbed along the waveform and snaps onto a chapter tick, which lights while the chapter chip pops up over it
say: when the speaker points to a podcast or a part of an episode ('I went deep on this on the podcast', 'skip to the part where...'): cut in on 'podcast', the snap and chip land on the chapter they name
